usability.videoClips: No failed-run artifacts were captured in this run. Trace, video, and screenshot evidence only appear when Playwright retains failure artifacts.

findings: No SEO-specific failures were produced in the current run.
strengths: Add explicit SEO checks to surface deterministic strengths in future runs.

recommendations.title: Keep the SEO audit in regression
recommendations.rationale: The current run is healthy. Preserve these checks in regression so metadata, schema, and crawler files stay stable over time.

comprehensive.label: Comprehensive accessibility
comprehensive.workerNote: One worker: tests ran one at a time, as the suite itself requires on every host.

summary.headline: No failures on 3 pages, 0 findings. That is not a clean bill of health: read what this run did not test.

model.note: No local model is configured (TESTFORGE_OLLAMA_MODEL), so it was not asked for scenarios. The template's checks stand on their own.

statements: Automated scanning finds about half of WCAG issues: axe-core states it finds 57% of them on average. A clean scan does not mean the pages are accessible.
Keyboard use, the screen-reader experience and whether the content is clear need a person to check.
Items the scan could not decide are listed as needing manual review, not counted as passed.
